description: Image Description: The image features a close-up view of a red apple hanging from a tree branch. The apple has a noticeable bite taken out of it, revealing the white flesh inside. Two wasps are present, one on the top left of the bitten area and the other on the bottom. The wasps are feeding on the exposed part of the apple. The background is blurred with hints of green foliage and a clear blue sky, suggesting a natural outdoor setting. There are also a few dry leaves
